sources.role: official per-platform data paths, portable mode and game deltas
official game data and save behavior

paths.path: ~/.local/share/Aaron Giles/DREAMM/config.json; portable mode uses config.json beside the dreamm executable and local subfolders.
evidence: docs:DREAMM 4.0 Data Files and Portable Mode

paths.path: config.json stores DREAMM keyboard/input options; the Keyboard option configures host-key mappings through the UI.
paths.naming: JSON configuration generated by DREAMM; no stable hand-authored controller-profile grammar is published.

paths.path: ~/.local/share/Aaron Giles/DREAMM/gamedeltas (DREAMM 3/4 name), containing files modified/created by each installed game; saves are game-native files.
paths.naming: Game-defined save files in the title's delta directory; the folder takes precedence over the read-only install folder.
evidence: docs:DREAMM 4.0 Accessing Game Data and Deltas Path

paths.path: DREAMM documents in-game Save/Load Game and game data deltas, but no separate emulator save-state slot/file facility.
paths.naming: Not applicable: game saves are not emulator machine states.

paths.path: No PC BIOS image is required. Optional MT-32 ROMs and SoundFonts are discovered in ~/.local/share/Aaron Giles/DREAMM/sounddata.
paths.naming: MT-32 ROM/SoundFont filenames are user-supplied; DREAMM does not publish a universal canonical checksum.

paths.path: No external decryption key file; LucasArts copy protection is handled by the game's protection setting/manual assistance.
